notes: The opening 'if' is added: the protasis writes no conjunction of its own (rule 55).
'that which he had taken by robbery' is all one unit for גְּזֵלָה under rule 46, headed on robbery.
'in the statutes of life' fronts the rectum's article to the phrase's left edge, so הַ takes the one written 'the' and the construct חֻקּוֹת stays bare (rule 29).
